    78	 * Encodes a pair of key and value into a url query string value.
    79	 *
    80	 * If the value is an array, it will be encoded as multiple key-value pairs with the same key.
    81	 *
    82	 * @example
    83	 *
    84	 * ```js
    85	 * encodeQueryItem('message', 'Hello World')
    86	 * // 'message=Hello+World'
    87	 *
    88	 * encodeQueryItem('tags', ['javascript', 'web', 'dev'])
    89	 * // 'tags=javascript&tags=web&tags=dev'
    90	 * ```
    91	 *
    92	 * @group Query_utils
    93	 */
    94	export function encodeQueryItem(
    95	  key: string,
    96	  value: QueryValue | QueryValue[],
    97	): string {
    98	  if (typeof value === "number" || typeof value === "boolean") {
    99	    value = String(value);
   100	  }
   101	  if (!value) {
   102	    return encodeQueryKey(key);
   103	  }
   104	
   105	  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
   106	    return value
   107	      .map(
   108	        (_value: QueryValue) =>
   109	          `${encodeQueryKey(key)}=${encodeQueryValue(_value)}`,
   110	      )
   111	      .join("&");
   112	  }
   113	
   114	  return `${encodeQueryKey(key)}=${encodeQueryValue(value)}`;
   115	}
   116	
   117	/**
   118	 * Stringfies and encodes a query object into a query string.
   119	 *
   120	 * @example
   121	 *
   122	 * ```js
   123	 * stringifyQuery({ foo: 'bar', baz: 'qux' })
   124	 * // 'foo=bar&baz=qux'
   125	 *
   126	 * stringifyQuery({ foo: 'bar', baz: undefined })
   127	 * // 'foo=bar'
   128	 * ```
   129	 *
   130	 * @group Query_utils
   131	 */
   132	export function stringifyQuery(query: QueryObject): string {
   133	  return Object.keys(query)
   134	    .filter((k) => query[k] !== undefined)
   135	    .map((k) => encodeQueryItem(k, query[k]))
   136	    .filter(Boolean)
   137	    .join("&");
   138	}
